title: Error `Parameter "fd" is null` when changing language in-game
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4.1.stable, 4.3.stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.12033.1030) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700G with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

When changing a language inside a game, under some circumstances there's an error spam with following contents:

```
E 0:00:01:412   translation_test.gd:6 @ _process(): Parameter "fd" is null.
  <C++ Source>  modules/text_server_adv/text_server_adv.cpp:2691 @ _font_get_ascent()
  <Stack Trace> translation_test.gd:6 @ _process()
```

This was originally spotted on C# where the error trace is as follows:

```
E 0:00:03:330   NativeCalls.cs:503 @ void Godot.NativeCalls.godot_icall_1_57(nint, nint, string): Parameter "fd" is null.
  <C++ Source>  modules/text_server_adv/text_server_adv.cpp:2691 @ _font_get_ascent()
  <Stack Trace> NativeCalls.cs:503 @ void Godot.NativeCalls.godot_icall_1_57(nint, nint, string)
                TranslationServer.cs:46 @ void Godot.TranslationServer.SetLocale(string)
                TranslationTest.cs:11 @ void TranslationTest._Process(double)
                Node.cs:2540 @ bool Godot.Node.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name&, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&)
                CanvasItem.cs:1654 @ bool Godot.CanvasItem.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name&, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&)
                Node2D.cs:557 @ bool Godot.Node2D.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name&, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&)
                TranslationTest_ScriptMethods.generated.cs:38 @ bool TranslationTest.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name&, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&)
                CSharpInstanceBridge.cs:24 @ Godot.NativeInterop.godot_bool Godot.Bridge.CSharpInstanceBridge.Call(nint, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant**, int, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant_call_error*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant*)
```

I tried to reproduce this problem from scratch with blank project, but it didn't wanted to happen, so I've stripped my game project as much as I could. I've also rewritten it to gdscript and the problem's there too.

It appears to only happen when there's a custom theme with default font set and internationalization being set up. Also, it appears to be somehow connected to some nodes having `visible` property set.

MRP contains two scenes and a theme resource, as well as some freeware fonts.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open MRP
2. Launch `translation_test.tscn`
3. Hit up/down keyboard keys repeatedly to change the language
4. Observe 60-150 errors as in description

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[repro_font_locale_error_spam_gdscript.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20299422/repro_font_locale_error_spam_gdscript.zip)
